blocks.text: BAGUIO CITY — The municipality of Besao in Mountain Province received its first historical marker recognizing the heritage significance of St. Benedict Episcopal Church. The marker recognizes the church’s role in the growth of the Episcopal Church in the Cordillera and its contribution to community life in Besao. St. Benedict Episcopal Church traces its origins to an outstation of the St. Mary the Virgin Mission in Sagada town in 1910. It became a full mission station in 1912 and eventually served as a central place of worship and community activity.
